📢ACTION TODAY
🚨 NYT STOP YOUR LIES 🇵🇸 
🗓️ Tuesday, October 21
⏰ 5:00 PM
📍 New York Times Building 

For two years, the brave healthcare workers of Gaza have risked their own lives to save their people amid Israel’s genocidal rampage. While Israel abducted doctors, bombed hospitals, and executed staff and patients, the New York Times was largely silent. Even worse, the Times has repeatedly published Israel’s baseless justifications for targeting every single hospital in Gaza. Join us to honor the thousands of Palestinian healthcare workers who have been martyred, and to hold the Times accountable for constantly whitewashing Israel’s atrocities.
